parameters.content:
## Stale signal nudge

On weekday mornings Scout reads your open Notion rows and emails you the
ones that have gone quiet for longer than their follow-up window.

It never contacts anyone in the list. The only message it sends is the
digest, to you.

Rows with next action **Ignore** and rows with status **Closed** are
skipped. A row that has never been touched ages from its creation date.

## Configure before running

1. Open **Scout Setup** and set your Notion database id and the address
   that should receive the nudge.
2. Bind a Notion credential on **Query Open Signals** (HTTP Header Auth)
   and a Gmail OAuth2 credential on **Email Nudge**.
3. Tune **staleDaysByAction**. Each window is a whole number of days
   from 1 to 90. The **default** key covers any action not listed.

This workflow ships with its timezone set to **UTC**. Change the
workflow timezone in workflow settings before you activate it, or the
morning run will fire at the wrong local hour.

## Limits worth knowing

**One page of results.** The Notion query asks for 100 rows and v0.1
does not follow the pagination cursor. Past 100 open rows the digest
covers only the first page Notion returns. Keep the board pruned, or
paginate before you rely on it.

**No email when nothing is stale.** **Any Stale?** routes an empty run
to **No Stale Signals** and stops. Scout does not send a "nothing to do"
message.

Names, angles and links come out of Notion and are HTML-escaped before
they reach the email. Only http and https links become clickable.
